item.question: Is there a 4-sided figure in which all the sides are equal in length but is not a square? If such a figure exists, can you construct it? a) Does such a figure exist? b) Can you construct it?
steps_tex: Take side length $5\text{ cm}$. Draw $AB = 5\text{ cm}$ and $AC = 5\text{ cm}$ with angle $A$, not equal to $90^\circ$, for example $60^\circ$.
The fourth point $D$ must be $5\text{ cm}$ from both $B$ and $C$.
With the compass at $5\text{ cm}$, draw an arc from $B$ and an arc from $C$. They cross at $D$.
Join $BD$ and $CD$. All four sides $AB$, $AC$, $BD$, $CD$ are $5\text{ cm}$.
The angles are not $90^\circ$, so it is not a square.
item.answer_tex: $(a)$: Yes, a rhombus (diamond) with four equal sides and angles that are not $90^\circ$; $(b)$: yes, it can be constructed with compass arcs.
